articles.title: Kingston IronKey Keypad 200 Series Achieves NIST FIPS 140-3 Level 3 Certification
articles.mainIdea: Kingston IronKey Keypad 200 Series Achieves NIST FIPS 140-3 Level 3 Certification
articles.summary: Business Wire: Kingston IronKey Keypad 200 Series Achieves NIST FIPS 140-3 Level 3 Certification. FOUNTAIN VALLEY, Calif., January 26, 2026--Kingston Digital, Inc., the Flash memory affiliate of Kingston Technology Company, Inc., a world leader in memory products and technology solutions, announces today its award-winning Kingston IronKey Keypad 200 series (KP200 and KP200C) hardware-encrypted USB flash drives have received NIST FIPS 140-3 Level 3 validation. This certification brings the KP200 series in line with IronKey D500S, which has already achieved this prestigious security standard,
